ui.about_lead: Atlasi y'obudde eteetaaga intaneeti, naye eyinza okufuna endembo bw'oyagala. Obudde bw'ensi yonna obutera okubaawo butegekeddwa mu app era busomeka nga tolina intaneeti; obudde obwa kaakano, okulagula obudde, okulabula, n'ebisaanikira bya raster bifunibwa bw'osaba byokka.

ui.about_privacy: Obubonero bw'eka yo n'olusalosalo lwa OpenWeatherMap bibeera mu browser eno yokka era tebiweebwayo wonna. App etandika nga terina ntaneeti n'akatono; ekozesa intaneeti bw'oba weetaaze data y'endembo yokka, ng'eweereza obukoodyo bwokka obwetaagisa.
ui.about_foot: Weatherglass — ya bwereere era ekola nga tolina intaneeti okusooka. Buli kya kusoma kirambika ekiseera kyakyo; bw'oba tolina intaneeti, obutera okubaawo obutegekeddwa bwe busigala.

ui.disc_body:
Weatherglass kyuma kya bubaka bwokka, si kiweereza kya bukuumi. Data y'obudde, okulagula obudde, ebyafaayo, n'okulabula okwa bukiiko, bifunibwa okuva mu nsibuko ez'ebweru (Open-Meteo, MET Norway, US National Weather Service, ebibiina by'obudde eby'amawanga, GDACS, ne OpenWeatherMap bw'oba ogasseeko olusalosalo lwo). Biyinza okulwawo, obutajjuvu, obutali butuufu, oba obutafunibwa, era Weatherglass eyinza obutabisoma bulungi oba obutabirambika.

Toozesa app eno okusalawo ku bintu ebikwata ku bulamu, obulungi bw'omubiri, ebintu, oba obukuumi mu lugendo — nga mw'otwalidde n'embuyaga, amataba, ennyonyi, envuba, okutambula ku nsozi, oba emirimu egy'ebweru. Bulijjo goberera bukiiko bwo obw'obudde n'ebiragiro by'okwerinda eggwanga lyo; okulabula kwabwe kulemererwa ku buli kirambise wano.

Atlasi y'obudde eteetaaga intaneeti erambika obutera bw'ebbanga eddene (1991–2020) n'ebikwata ku byafaayo. Enyonyola obudde obutera okubaawo, si obudde bwe bujja okubeera ku lunaku olw'enjawulo.

Ekifo kikozesebwa bwe onyiga okukikozesa kyokka, okufuna obudde ku kifo ekyo kyokka, era tekiterekebwa ffe wonna. Obubonero bw'eka yo n'entegeka bisigala ku kyuma kino.

Weatherglass eweebwa ya bwereere, “nga bwe kiri”, awatali bukakafu bwonna. Okutuuka we mateeka gakkiriza, omukozi waayo talina kuvunaanyizibwa ku kufiirwa oba obwonoonefu bwonna obuva mu kukozesa oba mu kwesigama ku bikubaawo.

Bw'onyiga Ntegedde era nkkiriza okakasa nti osomye obubaka buno. Bulambikibwa nate oluvannyuma lwa buli kudda ku ngeri empya.
